metadata.title: Arm Holdings Revenue Grows 27% on Strong Artificial Intelligence Demand - WSJ

content.text:
Arm Holdings ARM 6.71%increase; up pointing triangle recorded 27% growth in revenue in its fiscal second quarter, as artificial intelligence demand fuels growth.
The semiconductor company posted a profit of $130 million, or 12 cents a share, compared with $238 million, or 22 cents a share, a year earlier.
